The '''Ketton''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the celestial body [[Ket]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. Though [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]], they had an [[Insect/Legends|insect]]-like [[exoskeleton]]. Native to the [[Great Dalvechan Deserts]], the Ketton had evolved two pairs of [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that were slit-like as protection against their habitat's [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorms]], and they also had long, hollow [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]] that could be used to suck liquids from succulent [[Plant/Legends|plants]]. The Ketton had a nomadic society and were solitary beings by nature. By [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the Ketton [[Derrida/Legends|Derrida]] was an informant and [[Spy/Legends|spy]] who operated aboard the [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]] and elsewhere.

==Biology and appearance==
The Ketton were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who were native to the [[Great Dalvechan Deserts]] of the celestial body [[Ket]],<ref name="AIR" /> situated in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ket system/Legends|Ket system]]</ref> They stood 1.3 to 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had a resilient [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]]-like [[exoskeleton]] that resembled that of many [[Insect/Legends|insects]] and ranged from [[Color/Legends|white]] to dark brown in color, with most Ketton having light brown or tan exoskeletons.<ref name="AIR" /> They had a slender body build<ref name="AIR" /><ref name="AlienEncounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> with [[Limb/Legends|hands]] that ended in three digits. The legs of one Ketton, [[Derrida/Legends|Derrida]], had the lowest leg joint permenantly raised from the ground,<ref name="AIR" /> but members of the species could alternately have the lowest leg joint flat to the ground,<ref name="AlienEncounters" /> similar to [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

Ketton had two pairs of [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]; however, they were little more than slits in their heads so as to avoid the harsh [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorms]] of their native environment. Another adaptation the species had to their [[Water/Legends|arid]] habitat was their long, hollow [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]], which could be used to suck up reservoirs of liquid&mdash;including water&mdash;from various succulent [[Plant/Legends|plants]], such as the [[Stillar cactus|stillar cacti]].<ref name="AIR" />

==Society and culture==
[[File:Ket-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Ketton were native to Ket.]]
The Ketton were inherently a solitary species and led a nomadic lifestyle. Despite that, they also possessed an unusually strong sense of community, with individual Ketton putting in extra effort to aid other Ketton. The Ketton society had at least one&mdash;[[Gender/Legends|female]]&mdash;gender. Although Ketton could use their fangs&mdash;which made members of other species consider their appearance to be hideously wicked<ref name="AIR" /> and dangerous<ref name="AlienEncounters" />&mdash;in combat, they were generally a peaceful species and preferred not to do so,<ref name="AIR" /> believing that such an action would soil them.<ref name="AlienEncounters" />

==Ketton in the galaxy==
{{Quote|Derrida is certainly an individual we should keep our eyes on: after several discussions with Agent Kosciuscko, I learned it is suspected that she is responsible for the recent attempt on Meysen Kayson's life, one of our most important financiers.|Lak Sivrak, in a Rebel Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex file on Derrida|<ref name="AIR" />}}
Derrida was a mischievous female Ketton from Ket who operated as a freelance informant and [[Spy/Legends|spy]] aboard<ref name="AIR" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kwenn system/Legends|Kwenn system]]</ref> [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]] and elsewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="AIR" /> by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="2 ABY">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Her activities made the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] consider Derrida a threat,<ref name="AIR" /> and at some point between [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] and [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="KatarnDates">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}} dates the apprehension of [[Derrida]] to some point between [[Kyle Katarn]]'s [[mission to Ruusan]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], and a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Garos|military operation]] at [[Garos IV]]. The latter event is set concurrently with the events of {{JournalCite|12|Betrayal by Knight}}, which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].</ref> the Human [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] agent [[Kyle Katarn]] teamed up with a [[Max (bunny)|lagomorph individual]] to apprehend Derrida, in the process nearly destroying the Kwenn Space Station.<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|If this Star Wars character was intended as a caricature of the philosopher, it is of the most unflattering sort. Depicted as a bulbous-headed, gangly, fanged, four-eyed, triple-jointed limbed member of the alien Ketton race, Derrida is not only an Imperial spy but hideous.|Abel G. Peña|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|abelgpena|28|Deconstructing Dark Forces Part 2: The End of Continuity}}</ref>}}
[[File:Allianceintelligencereports.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Ketton were introduced in ''Alliance Intelligence Reports''.]]
The Ketton were first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, the Ketton Derrida was illustrated by [[Matt Busch]].<ref name="AIR" /> The author [[Abel G. Peña]]<ref name="Wizards" /><ref name="Blog" /> included a mention of Derrida in the [[April 7]], [[2005]] first installment of [[The Dark Forces Saga]] series of ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' source articles published on the [[Wizards.com|official website]] of [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="Wizards" /> Peña, who had added the mention as a reference to the real-world philosopher [[Wikipedia:Jacques Derrida|Jacques Derrida]], characterized the ''Alliance Intelligence Reports''{{'}} depiction of the Ketton as "hideous" and expressed the opinion that, if the original entry had likewise been intended as a reference to the philosopher, it was an "unflattering" caricature.<ref name="Blog" />
